correctness.rationale: For Moore rows \(v_i=\alpha^{q^{is}}\), Ho Lemma 4.1 gives \(\langle v_i,v_j\rangle_e=(S_{(j-i)s+e})^{q^{is}}\), nonzero exactly at \(j=i-es^{-1}\pmod{2m}\). Hence the proposed \(N-k\) consecutive rows are exactly the right orthogonal complement; reversing the pairing yields the left shift by \(+es^{-1}\). Intersecting either complementary cyclic interval with the first \(k\) rows gives \(\min\{k,\min(t,N-t)\}\). The bundled verifier checks both orientations through \(N=40\) and a direct \(\mathbb F_9\) source example. No finite computation is used to infer the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The complete Galois-hull profile is a natural structural invariant directly extending the recent scaled-basis construction beyond its single Hermitian endpoint. It supplies explicit right/left dual generators, identifies all LCD and self-orthogonal twists, and shows that the generalized step acts by a precise permutation of the twist parameter. These facts are useful for duality-based and entanglement-assisted constructions and are not an arbitrary finite slice or mere recomputation.
